title: Prosecution hits ‘trial and error’ in Zaldy Co case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution on Tuesday slammed the defense counsel of one of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co’s co-accused in a malversation case for what it deemed “trial and error” regarding their final witness, a remark the lawyer took exception to. Ultimately, the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division allowed the presentation of Jose Sumangil from the Department of Public Works and Highways’ (DPWH) Administrative Division in Region IV-B as a witness next week.
